t0007-01.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
t0007-01.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

t0007-02.gloss: A weather sketch and a water mark meet at an erased direction.
t0007-02.rival_reading: A response worker could note rain and drainage while planning a safe route; the erased word does not establish an agricultural release.
